_comment: Dev-only. Runs the Firestore emulator on the port dev-server.mjs patches app.js to use (8080), with the REAL firestore.rules loaded so a local walkthrough exercises the same permissions production does. Paths are relative to the PROJECT dir (the repo root, which is cwd when this runs), not to this file -- firebase refuses a rules path outside the project. Not the deploy config -- that is firebase.json, which deliberately has no emulators block because the Auth emulator would refuse to start without one and firebase.json is a tracked file the live project deploys from.
